prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1176; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end motor vehicle collision involving your insured. Our client has suffered physical injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment, and we expect the full extent of those injuries and associated losses to be documented as care continues.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. Any inquiries from your company or its representatives should be routed through our firm.

We request that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force on the date of loss, including all liability limits, and disclose whether any additional coverage, excess, or umbrella policies may apply.

Your company is also on notice of its obligation to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle and telematics data, repair and appraisal records, and any electronic communications. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.
